source: real: bench4 run 2 (Sanad), round 1 fix 59d3f45c334 on c33e1cbe13f (round 1 = 397133a409, pin.patch); the round 2 re-check found F1 (bench4-sanad-notes/RESULT.md, 'New bugs that round 2 found')

faults.wrong: The shared helper did not reach the Settings identity badges, which still print the raw English role on an Arabic page.
The helper's comment says one rule for every screen while the Settings badges and the ticket pages do not use it.
The logo link's aria-label and alt stay English on an Arabic page.
A saved session with no roles field crashes the top bar: user?.roles[0] reads a field that is undefined.
The view-as strip crashes the same way on a user with no roles field.
A session saved before roles was stored throws 'user.roles is not iterable' when the scope key spreads it.
The ticket pages keep the tickets.role words, whose Arabic Admin word differs from the shared helper's and which have no Applicant word.
The Users export builds role words from a fixed list of five, so an Applicant row is exported with the raw English role in Arabic.
The top bar shows only roles[0], so a user with combined roles sees one role.
A role name of only spaces is returned as it is, so the strip shows a blank role.

notes.text: eduquest-frontend/src/utils/role-helpers.ts:52 — role 'Admin' → the key users.enums.roles.admin is missing in the Arabic words, so the raw English name shows — add the word
eduquest-frontend/src/pages/settings/SettingsPage.tsx:458 — an Arabic page → the identity badge prints {role} raw while the helper comment says every screen — call getRoleLabel there
